chunks: "Leave the tawaf while you still desire it."

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.الطَّوَافَ: the ritual circumambulation around the Kaʿbah
key_terms.تَشْتَهِيهِ: you still desire it; you remain inclined toward it

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about when to stop tawaf?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام instructs that one should conclude the tawaf while still retaining eagerness for it. The wording conveys disciplined moderation in worship and proper conduct during hajj.
